Xtrata · deployment canary

Xtrata Arcade launch canary

Ships an arcade release in the only safe order. The arcade is recursive: only the packs that changed since the single-file bundle (#3078) are inscribed, then a small parent that loads every part of the hall from those packs or from the bundle. The canary checks the leaderboard contract (deploying it only if it is missing), inscribes the packs and the parent, reads every byte back and resolves every part from the chain exactly as the parent will, opens a test board bound to the parent, submits and re-plays a real arcade run, proves a copied run is refused, closes the test board, and only then points the 26 production boards at the parent. Each step unlocks only when the one before it has passed, and each re-reads the chain rather than trusting this page.

Wallet extensions do not inject into file:// pages. Serve this folder instead: python3 -m http.server 8080, then open http://localhost:8080/arcade-launch-canary.html.
